import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    cuts = []
    parity = [0, 0]

    for i in range(n):
        if i != 0 and parity[0] == parity[1]:
            cuts.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]))
        parity[arr[i] & 1] += 1

    cuts.sort()

    count = 0
    remaining = b
    for cost in cuts:
        if cost <= remaining:
            count += 1
            remaining -= cost

    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
